system.description: A Background available only to the thin-blooded Last Generations (fourteenth and fifteenth generation). A rare few among the thin-blooded have a knack for glimpsing the schemes of the elders through weird visions, uncomfortable hunches and prophetic dreams. Insight is not directed or intentional by default: it comes unbidden, is usually obscure and symbolic, and grows less clear the more important the event or powerful the vampire involved. The Storyteller decides when a spontaneous vision, hunch or dream occurs and what it reveals, often to seed plots and subplots. Insight can also be invoked deliberately (a Static Mental Challenge against 4 to 10 Traits depending on desired detail, retested with Occult), attempted together with other seers for greater detail at the risk of Insight Shock, and can manifest involuntarily while in torpor. Insight pertains only to the conflicts and schemes of vampires and is not guaranteed to relate to the wider Jyhad or Gehenna.
